title: Clockwork Nightingale
summary: An interactive Three.js cutaway of a jewelled cam-driven singing mechanical bird with articulated gears and escapement movement.
description: An interactive Three.js / WebGL2 cutaway of a jewelled cam-driven singing mechanical nightingale inside an aureate cabinet. Inspect the interlocking brass gears, cams, bellows, and articulated wings while switching between guided showcase and free orbit.
